title: VIXEN USE_CCACHE OFF does not clear cached compiler launchers
body: A fresh queued CMake configure/build kept invoking ccache after -DUSE_CCACHE=OFF and CCACHE_DISABLE=1 because CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER and CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER remained cached. The lane had to reconfigure with both launcher cache variables explicitly empty before direct compiler commands appeared; the full target was then still queue-stall-killed. Derive launcher cache invalidation from USE_CCACHE so native witnesses do not need manual cache surgery.
